problems.problem:
A disk-shaped spiral galaxy has an angular diameter of $1.22'$, its distance from the observer is 40 megaparsecs and the plane of the galaxy is parallel to the line of sight. Due to the Doppler effect a shift in the wavelength of 21 [cm] (neutral hydrogen line) of 0.01516 [cm] is measured when one end of the galaxy is observed. Determine:

(a) The real diameter of the galaxy.
(b) The rotation velocity of the end of the galaxy.
(c) By gravitation, calculate the mass of the galaxy.

($G = 6.6739 \times 10^{-11}\ \frac{m^3}{kg\,s^2}$)
